name: Return to the Marsh
label: Quest
description: Return to the Marsh: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is time, friend, for you to speak with Tabetha... The hermit of Dustwallow Marsh. She will instruct you on the creation of a powerful mage's implement.
Tabetha's shack lies deep in Dustwallow Marsh, west of Theramore.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, yes. You are here for an orb or a staff, friend? Very well. I will aid you in its construction.
But be forewarned--the process is a perilous one and could mean your death.
Or my death. Definitely someone's death...
But let's hope it's someone else's death, eh?
